name: linux-envelope-flat-additive-back-read-compat
description: Back-read-compatibility regression for the v0.7.0 additive envelope (LBA-REQ-013), locking in the two hard constraints WIN verified on the Windows plane (bus finding 17812593), both rooted in the v1 flat-object extractor regex + the Ordinal schema check in CollabMessage.TryParse. POSITIVE: a FLAT envelope carrying scalar prio/agentId/to parses through the real reader and round-trips (urgent-p0-to-linux with `- prio: P0` and `- agentId: LINUX-a` rendered) — so an older reader parses-and-ignores rather than dropping. NEGATIVE (must fail-when-they-should): a NESTED priority object and a schema@v2 bump each defeat the v1 extractor and are SILENTLY DROPPED, so poll shows neither `nested-priority-must-drop` nor `schema-bumped-must-drop`. If a future change relaxed constraint (1) flat-scalars or (2) schema==v1, a dropped marker would surface here and fail the gate.
